name: Quadratic Bezier Tube Deformation
definition: A deformation technique using quadratic Bezier curves instead of cubic splines. A segment is defined by three control points A, B, and C. It starts at A (t=0), ends at C (t=1), is tangent to AB at t=0 and BC at t=1.
summary: Quadratic Bezier Tube Deformation maps arbitrary spline tubes to canonical cylinders for volume rendering, prioritizing computational simplicity over the ease of segment concatenation found in cubic approaches.
